entries.810fe1e6138166a3: Founded in 1953, the company has its head office in Owariasahi City, Aichi Prefecture, and is listed on the Main Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
entries.845c0f7f6ce2a099: Under its management philosophy, “Through reliable manufacturing, contribute to society and aim for the company's continuous development,” it says it will accurately grasp market needs, provide high-quality, high value-added products, strengthen its R&D structure, and work on developing new technologies and new products. In precision metal-processed products, it is pursuing productivity gains through the “Ｄｏ Ｎｏｗ！ Reform Activities” and winning new automotive parts orders, including for EVs, while for small-caliber ammunition it aims to establish a production system that delivers high-performance, high-quality manufacturing and responds to changes in the security environment. In the Machinery Division, in addition to developing and selling press machines for battery cans and others, it says it is working to open up the North American market through a local subsidiary established in the United States.

Sales to the Ministry of Defense, its largest customer, account for 34.2% of total sales.
